buM <expan>pa'i</expan> kha dog de khyod kyi gzung don du <expan>med par thal</expan> ¦ buM <expan>pa'i</expan> kha dog de khyod la rang <lb n="7b2"/> 'dra'i rnaM pa <expan>dngos su</expan> gtod byed min <expan>pa'i phyir</expan> ¦ <expan>der thal</expan> ¦ buM <expan>pa'i</expan> kha dog de khyod kyi dngos kyi spyod yul min <expan>pa'i phyir</expan> ¦
